title: The Oracle of Tarot
author: Paul Foster Case
edition: The typed lessons, as the School issued them to its students; the typescript is undated
publicDomain: Paul Foster Case died in 1954. Lessons issued privately to the School's students and never published were, under US law, in copyright for seventy years after his death: in the public domain since 1 January 2025.
note: Set from the School's typed lessons, contributed by Tony DeLuce, as transcribed and corrected for agelesswisdom.school (that site's repository, rosicrucian-dev/agelesswisdom, holds the work of reading them in), and brought here in October 2026 with the words unchanged.
